}}'''Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency''' ('''ZIMSTAT''') is the [[statistics agency]] of [[Zimbabwe]]. It is headquartered  in the Kaguvi Building in [[Harare]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.zimstat.co.zw/contact-us |title=Contact Us &#124; Zimbabwe National Statistics |website=www.zimstat.co.zw |access-date=12 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190904000411/http://www.zimstat.co.zw/contact-us |archive-date=4 September 2019 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

Census and Statistics Act of 2007 created the agency.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.zimstat.co.zw/about-us|title=About Us|publisher=Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency|access-date=2020-03-24}}</ref> It replaced the '''Central Statistical Office''' ('''CSO''').<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.zimstat.co.zw/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071124141744/http://www.zimstat.co.zw/|url-status=dead|archive-date=2007-11-24|title=Home|publisher=Central Statistical Office|date=2007-11-24|access-date=2020-03-24}}</ref> It was headquartered in the Kaguvi Building in Harare.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.zimstat.co.zw/html/contactus.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071124145214/http://www.zimstat.co.zw/html/contactus.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=2007-11-24|title=Contact Us|publisher=Central Statistical Office|date=2007-11-24|access-date=2020-03-24}}</ref>
